'''Sil Vaturha''' was an orphaned [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. She was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by [[Kaylo NaKuda]], a [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], as a [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] in his underground [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] garage, [[Kuda's Compound]], on the planet [[Stend VI]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Sil Vaturha was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was orphaned at a young age. She grew up on the streets of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] before being sold into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]. [[Kaylo NaKuda]], a [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], purchased Vaturha and forced her to work in his underground [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] garage, [[Kuda's Compound]], on the planet [[Stend VI]]. Varturha worked for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before she became his top [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] for a year sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="WHSV" />

==Personality and traits==
Vaturha was quiet, introspective, and preferred the company of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and machines because organics had been cruel to her.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Skills and abilities==
From swoops to [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], Vaturha could repair almost any kind of vehicle. She was also skilled at [[Computer/Legends|computer]] repair and had acquired urban survival skills from her years on the streets.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Equipment==
Because of her occupation, Vaturha often carried around various tools, including a [[Fusioncutter/Legends|fusioncutter]], a [[Beamdrill/Legends|beamdrill]], a [[Laser welder/Legends|laser-welder]], a [[Diagnostic scanner/Legends|diagnostic scanner]], [[Hydrospanner/Legends|hydrospanners]], and repair kits. She was kept in line by NaKuda with a [[Vector Technologies|Vec-Tech]] [[AA-2 Keeper]]. The device was implanted into her skin, and if she attempted escape, it would release an exotic [[Neurotoxin/Legends|neurotoxin]] that would instantly [[Death/Legends|kill]] her. She also wore a decorative headdress, wrappings on her left<ref name="WHSV" /> [[Lekku/Legends|lek]],<ref name="TEGtAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> and a [[Clothing/Legends|top]] with breast pockets.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sil Vaturha was designed by [[Paul Danner]] and [[Bill Smith]] for ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1997]]. She was illustrated by [[Greg Smith (illustrator)|Greg Smith]].<ref name="WHSV" />
